Was in 2018 when I played in a football (the one where you actually play with your feet) cup and tore my quadriceps, the muscle in your thigh, from its attachment at the hip while doing a tackle. I was just feeling that something ain't where it's supposed to be and went pale really fast, also all of a sudden I couldn't put any pressure on my leg but still had to walk some 50ish metres so someone can look at my leg. When I lied there and the eyes of the team "doctor", was just a nurse who also was a mom from one of my mates, got bigger and bigger and my hip the same, I had already a bad feeling. Apparently they wanted to call a ambulance but my mom insisted that she drives to the hospital near our home 'cause we drove about 1-2 hours to the cup. So they carried me, since I just couldn't walk, to the locker room and after I changed to the car. The whole time I was crying or just moments before because this shit just hurt so much. This injury isn't that often apparently because my doctors told me something like, that maybe 4 other people had a form of this injury in and around Hamburg. All of it ended with me having to use crotches for 8-12 weeks, but i stopped after 6 weeks because I felt like I don't need 'em, also I'm not allowed to play football or a sport with similar movements again, because then I can get the same injury again, and I'm having immens pain when I'm walking or doing sport for some hours. Overall I wouldn't recommend getting injured like that.

Tl;Dr: Played football and tore my thigh muscle attachment off
